discovery.title: A record number of whale calves have died in Patagonia
discovery.summary: More than 300 southern right whale calves have died since June; researchers detected a disease-causing bacterium in samples, but its role in the die-off remains unclear.
discovery.why_it_matters: The episode raises questions about how infection, animal health and environmental conditions interact in a recovering whale population.

discovery.title: A tiny marine microbe is testing how small life can get
discovery.summary: Researchers identified genetic material from a marine microbe inside plankton off Japan. Its highly reduced genome appears to depend on a host, and the organism has not yet been directly observed.
discovery.why_it_matters: Understanding how cells rely on hosts could reshape research on microbial ecosystems and the boundary between cellular life and virus-like dependence.
